papers.title: Neural Network Backflow with Low-Rank Multi-Determinant Updates
papers.abstract: Simulating strongly correlated fermions remains a long-standing challenge due to the exponential complexity of the Hilbert space and the intricate sign structure of many-body wavefunctions. We introduce a variational framework centered on a neural network backflow transformation that combines deep learning with variational Monte Carlo. The proposed ansatz employs a multi-determinant expansion with low-rank shifts to capture non-local correlations and complex sign structures. Applied to the two-dimensional Hubbard model at both half-filling and $1/8$ doping, the method achieves energies within $0.45\%$ of auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo at half-filling and captures intertwined charge- and spin-density stripe patterns at $1/8$ doping. These results demonstrate the potential of this framework as a scalable and interpretable approach to variational simulations of strongly correlated fermionic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：variational framework、variational Monte Carlo、neural network backflow、ansatz、模拟（simulating）。；研究对象：强关联费米子系统，具体为二维 Hubbard 模型，研究其在半填充（half-filling）和 1/8 掺杂（1/8 doping）下的基态性质，包括能量与电荷/自旋密度条纹图案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该神经网络 backflow 变分方法在半填充时能量达到辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（AFQMC）结果的 0.45% 以内，并在 1/8 掺杂时捕捉到电荷与自旋密度交织的条纹（stripe）图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该神经网络 backflow 变分方法在半填充时能量达到辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（AFQMC）结果的 0.45% 以内，并在 1/8 掺杂时捕捉到电荷与自旋密度交织的条纹（stripe）图案。；创新点：提出将神经网络 backflow 变换与低秩多行列式更新相结合的变分拟设，用以捕捉非局域关联与复杂符号结构，并在二维 Hubbard 模型上验证了其可扩展性与可解释性（摘要未明确说明与已有方法的具体量化对比细节）。
papers.method_zh: 以神经网络 backflow 变换为核心的变分框架，结合深度学习与变分蒙特卡洛（variational Monte Carlo）；所用拟设（ansatz）采用低秩位移（low-rank shifts）的多行列式展开（multi-determinant expansion）来捕捉非局域关联和复杂符号结构。对比基准为辅助场量子蒙特卡洛（AFQMC）。

papers.title: Deep Generative Crystal Structure Prediction: A Benchmark Study and a Controlled Test of Prototype Dependence
papers.abstract: Deep generative models are widely reported to enable de novo crystal structure prediction (CSP), but their capability has not been measured consistently against template-based methods. We evaluate 12 representative generative CSP models, spanning latent-variable, diffusion, flow-matching, autoregressive, and manifold random-walk architectures, against TCSP 2.0 on 180 test structures and a leakage-controlled subset of 46. All methods use identical structure-matching, symmetry, and consensus criteria. Template retrieval is the strongest single method, reaching 68.3% top-1 success; symmetry-aware EquiCSP (66.4%) and Uni-3DAR (62.9%) form the next tier. However, comparison with TCSP 2.0 shows that most structures correctly predicted by generative models are also correctly predicted by template substitution. Thus, the set of structures uniquely reachable by generation is small, limiting its practical advantage for discovering structures outside existing prototype libraries. To test the source of this performance, we removed entire stoichiometric prototype families from the training set and retrained the strongest generative model. Accuracy declined by 50-78% across four families, establishing that performance is substantially prototype-dependent. A small minority of structures survived removal of their prototype family, demonstrating a real but limited retrieval-independent predictive capacity. Present generative CSP models therefore function largely as implicit, softer-edged prototype libraries rather than genuinely de novo predictors. Enlarging this residual capacity, rather than aggregate match rate alone, is the central open problem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：deep generative models、benchmark study、retrained、training set、test structures、structure-matching criteria——全文为对生成模型的基准评测与受控实验，不涉及真实材料合成或实验测量。；研究对象：深度生成晶体结构预测（CSP）模型本身，具体为12个代表性生成式CSP模型（涵盖隐变量、扩散、流匹配、自回归、流形随机游走架构），以及作为对照的模板方法TCSP 2.0。物理现象层面关注的是晶体结构预测的成功率及其对训练集中原型家族的依赖。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模板检索是最强的单一方法（top-1成功率68.3%），且生成模型正确预测的大多数结构同样可被模板替换正确预测，生成方法独有可达的结构集合很小；当从训练集中移除整个化学计量原型家族后，最强生成模型的准确率下降50–78%，表明其性能高度依赖原型，生成式CSP模型在很大程度上充当隐式的、边界更软的"原型库"，而非真正的从头预测器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模板检索是最强的单一方法（top-1成功率68.3%），且生成模型正确预测的大多数结构同样可被模板替换正确预测，生成方法独有可达的结构集合很小；当从训练集中移除整个化学计量原型家族后，最强生成模型的准确率下降50–78%，表明其性能高度依赖原型，生成式CSP模型在很大程度上充当隐式的、边界更软的"原型库"，而非真正的从头预测器。；创新点：首次在统一的结构匹配、对称性与共识标准下，将多种架构的生成式CSP模型与模板方法TCSP 2.0进行一致性对比；并通过移除原型家族的受控再训练实验，定量分离出生成模型性能中依赖原型与独立于检索的部分，指出扩大残余的检索无关预测能力（而非仅提高总体匹配率）才是核心开放问题。
papers.method_zh: 对12个代表性生成式CSP模型与TCSP 2.0进行基准评测，在180个测试结构及一个泄漏控制的46结构子集上比较，所有方法采用统一的结构匹配、对称性和共识判据；并进行了受控实验：从训练集中移除整个化学计量原型家族后重新训练最强生成模型，观察准确率变化。

papers.title: Extraordinary Lifetime Enhancement of Coherent Phonon-Amplitude Modes in the Excitonic Insulator Phase of Ta2Pd3Te5
papers.abstract: The excitonic insulator (EI) is an electronic phase of condensed excitons. However, in many prototypical materials the presence of a concurrent structural transition complicates the identification of a purely electronic origin of the ordered state. Here, we investigate Ta2Pd3Te5, in which an EI phase develops below TC ~ 100 K in the absence of a detectable structural transition. We characterize the excitonic condensate via its coherent phonon-amplitude response. Most strikingly, an extraordinarily strong lifetime enhancement of these modes sets in below TC which we establish as a new and robust fingerprint linked to exciton condensation. We discuss possibilities to capture the enhancement when taking into account a coupling of excitonic and lattice effects in line with the coupled phonon-amplitude response. Within an order-parameter polaron picture coupling to the excitonic state may dress the phonon mode and thereby suppress its relaxation and a phenomenological model combines the anharmonic phonon response and a reduced electronic scattering due to the gap opening in the EI phase.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼含理论建模）。判断依据的关键词：investigate Ta2Pd3Te5、characterize the excitonic condensate via its coherent phonon-amplitude response、we establish as a new and robust fingerprint、a phenomenological model combines...（既有材料测量与表征，也有唯象理论建模）。；研究对象：激子绝缘体（EI）材料 Ta2Pd3Te5，其在 TC ~ 100 K 以下发展出激子绝缘体相，且没有可探测到的结构相变；研究的具体物理现象是该相中的相干声子-振幅模式的响应与寿命。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 TC 以下，相干声子-振幅模式出现极其强烈的寿命增强，这一增强被确立为与激子凝聚相关联的新且稳健的指纹特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 TC 以下，相干声子-振幅模式出现极其强烈的寿命增强，这一增强被确立为与激子凝聚相关联的新且稳健的指纹特征。；创新点：在无结构相变伴随的 Ta2Pd3Te5 中研究纯电子起源的激子绝缘体相，并提出相干声子-振幅模式的超强寿命增强作为与激子凝聚相关的新的稳健指纹；同时从激子-晶格耦合的角度给出唯象解释。
papers.method_zh: 通过相干声子-振幅响应（coherent phonon-amplitude response）来表征激子凝聚；并采用唯象模型，将非谐声子响应与 EI 相中能隙打开导致的电子散射减弱结合起来；同时在序参量极化子（order-parameter polaron）图像下讨论激子与晶格耦合对声子模式的修饰。摘要未明确说明具体使用的实验装置（如泵浦-探测光谱的具体配置）或计算方法。

papers.title: Reinterpreting ultrafast experiments on supercooled water: Glass transition versus liquid-liquid criticality
papers.abstract: Water's anomalous properties have been hypothesized to originate from a liquid-liquid critical point in the supercooled regime, separating high- and low-density liquid states. Experimental verification remains challenging due to rapid crystallization under these conditions. A recent study reported evidence for such a transition, based primarily on a pronounced increase in the heat capacity of rapidly heated low-density amorphous ice. Here, we show that this heat capacity increase can be explained without invoking a liquid-liquid transition. By combining simulations using a machine-learning potential trained on the state-of-the-art MB-pol water model, combined with the Tool-Narayanaswamy-Moynihan (TNM) model of the glass transition, we demonstrate that the observed signal can arise instead from a dynamical effect induced by the mobilization of rotational and translational molecular degrees of freedom during ultrafast heating. We further show that our findings are fully consistent with recent electron diffraction measurements showing structural arrest of supercooled water close to our predicted glass-transition temperature. These results provide an alternative interpretation of the experimental observations and highlight the importance of nonequilibrium glassy dynamics in the interpretation of the behavior of supercooled water on ultra-short time scales.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据的关键词：simulations、machine-learning potential、MB-pol water model、TNM model、demonstrate、alternative interpretation。摘要中未报告新的实验测量，而是对已有实验结果的重新解释。；研究对象：过冷水的异常性质及其假说来源——液-液临界点（LLCP），以及快速加热低密度非晶冰（LDA）时热容显著增加的实验信号。涉及的具体物理现象包括玻璃转变、液-液转变、超快加热下的非平衡玻璃态动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 快速加热低密度非晶冰时观测到的热容增加，可以不引入液-液转变、而用玻璃转变中的动力学效应来解释：超快加热过程中分子转动和平动自由度的“动员”即可产生该信号。该解释与近期电子衍射测量显示的、在预测玻璃转变温度附近过冷水的结构冻结一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：快速加热低密度非晶冰时观测到的热容增加，可以不引入液-液转变、而用玻璃转变中的动力学效应来解释：超快加热过程中分子转动和平动自由度的“动员”即可产生该信号。该解释与近期电子衍射测量显示的、在预测玻璃转变温度附近过冷水的结构冻结一致。；创新点：对近期报道的“过冷水中液-液转变证据”提出了不依赖液-液临界点的替代解释，指出超快时间尺度上非平衡玻璃态动力学在解读过冷水行为中的重要性，并与电子衍射结果自洽。
papers.method_zh: 使用在先进 MB-pol 水模型上训练的机器学习势进行模拟，并结合描述玻璃转变的 Tool-Narayanaswamy-Moynihan（TNM）模型进行分析。

papers.title: Linear and nonlinear active microrheology of viscous, viscoelastic, and elastic media: A fluid particle dynamics approach
papers.abstract: Active microrheology is an effective tool to determine the rheological properties of viscous, viscoelastic, or elastic materials on microscopic length scales. The positional response of an embedded probe particle to an externally applied oscillating driving force allows to indirectly characterize the properties of the surrounding media. We aim to explore the linear and nonlinear response of probe particles in a microrheological setup of planar geometry. For this purpose, we extend the computational method of fluid particle dynamics from viscous fluid-like to viscoelastic and elastic media, including nonlinear regimes. We consider a system confined by solid walls. In this case, we validate the approach by quantifying the linear response in terms of a Jeffreys model. Increasing the amplitude of the driving force, we observe distinct nonlinear effects. They include distorted stress-strain curves and a gradual net drift of probe particles initially positioned close to a wall. This drift vanishes in the viscous fluid-like and elastic solid-like limits, but is manifest for intermediate viscoelastic systems. We further address a setup of two probe particles in the absence of walls. They experience reciprocal pairwise oscillatory forcing. Here, nonlinearities in viscoelastic systems induce a net drift gradually moving the particles further apart from each other. Comparing with real setups, our implementation of the driving force is in line with experimental setups of optical tweezers or active magnetic microrheology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键依据：摘要明确说明“extend the computational method of fluid particle dynamics”，属于对计算方法的扩展与应用，而非实验测量或纯理论推导。；研究对象：微流变学（active microrheology）体系中的探针粒子响应行为。具体包括：平面几何构型下被固体壁面限制的单个探针粒子，以及无壁面条件下两个探针粒子之间的相互作用；研究介质涵盖黏性流体、黏弹性介质和弹性介质，涉及线性与非线性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在壁面限制的平面构型中，增大驱动力振幅会出现非线性效应，包括应力-应变曲线畸变以及靠近壁面的探针粒子逐渐产生净漂移；该漂移在黏性流体极限和弹性固体极限下消失，但在中间黏弹性体系中显著存在。在无壁面的双探针体系中，黏弹性介质的非线性效应会诱导粒子间产生净漂移，使两粒子逐渐远离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在壁面限制的平面构型中，增大驱动力振幅会出现非线性效应，包括应力-应变曲线畸变以及靠近壁面的探针粒子逐渐产生净漂移；该漂移在黏性流体极限和弹性固体极限下消失，但在中间黏弹性体系中显著存在。在无壁面的双探针体系中，黏弹性介质的非线性效应会诱导粒子间产生净漂移，使两粒子逐渐远离。；创新点：将流体粒子动力学方法从黏性流体扩展至黏弹性和弹性介质，并系统研究了微流变学中的非线性响应，揭示了黏弹性体系中特有的探针粒子净漂移现象（包括壁面附近的单粒子和无壁面的双粒子情形），而该漂移在纯黏性流体和纯弹性固体极限下均不存在。
papers.method_zh: 扩展了流体粒子动力学（fluid particle dynamics）计算方法，将其从黏性流体推广至黏弹性介质和弹性介质，并涵盖非线性区域。在壁面限制体系中，通过与 Jeffreys 模型描述的线性响应进行对比来验证方法。驱动力施加方式与光镊或主动磁微流变实验一致。

papers.title: Observation of the Nernst effect driven by longitudinal spin fluctuations
papers.abstract: The Nernst effect, which converts a heat current into a charge current in the orthogonal direction, is generally classified into the ordinary effect due to an external magnetic field applied to conductors and the anomalous effect due to static magnetization in magnetic materials. Thus, one expects that the anomalous Nernst effect disappears at the Curie temperature following the magnetization. Here, we observe the Nernst effect which rather manifests around the Curie temperature. In a series of ferromagnetic (Mn,Cr)Sb samples, the Nernst coefficients exhibit finite values even across the Curie temperatures, whereas the anomalous Hall resistivity disappears, suggesting the breakdown of the Mott relation. These surviving Nernst and vanishing Hall effects result in a peak behavior of the transverse thermoelectric conductivity around the Curie temperature, which we theoretically reproduce by introducing longitudinal fluctuations of spins without accounting for an exotic spin texture, a non-trivial electronic structure, or magnon- and phonon-drag effects. The Nernst effect driven by the longitudinal spin fluctuations reveals that not only the static magnetic order but also the spin fluctuations can be a driving force of the Nernst effect in magnetic materials, opening another way for boosting transverse thermoelectric conversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合型。关键判断依据：摘要中既有“we observe the Nernst effect”（实验观测），又有“we theoretically reproduce”（理论复现），属于实验观测结合理论解释的工作。；研究对象：铁磁(Mn,Cr)Sb系列样品中的能斯特效应（Nernst effect），特别是居里温度附近的横向热电输运行为，以及纵向自旋涨落对能斯特效应的驱动作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在(Mn,Cr)Sb铁磁样品中，能斯特系数在居里温度附近甚至跨越居里温度时仍保持有限值，而反常霍尔电阻率却消失，表明Mott关系失效；这种残余能斯特效应与消失的霍尔效应共同导致横向热电导在居里温度附近出现峰值行为，理论上可通过引入自旋的纵向涨落来复现，无需借助奇异自旋织构、非平庸电子结构或磁子/声子拖曳效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在(Mn,Cr)Sb铁磁样品中，能斯特系数在居里温度附近甚至跨越居里温度时仍保持有限值，而反常霍尔电阻率却消失，表明Mott关系失效；这种残余能斯特效应与消失的霍尔效应共同导致横向热电导在居里温度附近出现峰值行为，理论上可通过引入自旋的纵向涨落来复现，无需借助奇异自旋织构、非平庸电子结构或磁子/声子拖曳效应。；创新点：首次观测到由纵向自旋涨落驱动的能斯特效应，表明不仅静态磁有序，自旋涨落本身也可以成为磁性材料中能斯特效应的驱动力，打破了传统认为反常能斯特效应随磁化消失而消失的预期，为增强横向热电转换提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上测量了一系列铁磁(Mn,Cr)Sb样品的能斯特系数和反常霍尔电阻率随温度的变化；理论上通过引入自旋的纵向涨落来复现居里温度附近横向热电导的峰值行为。摘要未明确说明具体的实验测量装置、样品制备方法或理论计算框架（如是否为第一性原理、模型哈密顿量等）。

papers.title: Effect of interaction range on the phase diagram of magnetic hedgehog lattices
papers.abstract: Topological spin textures have attracted considerable attention through their emergent electromagnetic properties, including the topological Hall effect and the topological Nernst effect. Among them, magnetic hedgehog lattices (HLs) are three-dimensional topological spin textures that host emergent magnetic monopoles and antimonopoles. HLs have been identified in metallic compounds, such as $\mathrm{MnSi}_{1-x}\mathrm{Ge}_x$ and $\mathrm{SrFeO_3}$. Various theoretical models have been proposed, with either short-range or long-range interactions, which are typically regarded as effective descriptions of insulating and metallic systems, respectively. However, the role of the interaction range in stabilizing the HLs remains only partially understood. To address this gap, we investigate the stability of HLs by systematically varying the range and spatial decay of the exchange interactions, thereby interpolating between interaction profiles commonly associated with localized-spin insulating models and itinerant-electron metallic models. Based on extensive Monte Carlo simulations, we find that HLs are stabilized over a broad interaction range. Intriguingly, among the interaction profiles examined, intermediate-range interactions are particularly favorable for stabilizing HLs. They give rise to two distinct types of $3Q$-HLs that differ in the number of monopole-antimonopole pairs per magnetic unit cell, and their relative stability depends sensitively on the interaction range. Our results provide a unified framework for tuning phase diagrams from microscopic interaction models, serving as a guideline for interpreting experiments in candidate materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据的关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、theoretical models、interaction profiles、phase diagrams，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：磁性刺猬晶格（magnetic hedgehog lattices, HLs）——一种三维拓扑自旋结构，具有涌现磁单极子和反单极子。相关候选材料包括金属化合物 MnSi₁₋ₓGeₓ 和 SrFeO₃。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: HLs 在广泛的相互作用范围内均可被稳定；其中中等程相互作用特别有利于稳定 HLs，并产生两种不同的 3Q-HL 类型（区别在于每个磁单胞中单极-反单极对的数量），其相对稳定性敏感依赖于相互作用范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：HLs 在广泛的相互作用范围内均可被稳定；其中中等程相互作用特别有利于稳定 HLs，并产生两种不同的 3Q-HL 类型（区别在于每个磁单胞中单极-反单极对的数量），其相对稳定性敏感依赖于相互作用范围。；创新点：系统性地揭示了相互作用范围对 HLs 稳定性的作用，填补了此前对相互作用范围如何稳定 HLs 理解不足的空白；发现中等程相互作用最有利于稳定 HLs，并识别出两种不同的 3Q-HL 类型，为从微观相互作用模型调控相图提供了统一框架，并为候选材料的实验解释提供指导。

papers.title: Counterions between walls with surface charge modulations: Exact Poisson-Boltzmann solutions
papers.abstract: We study the thermal equilibrium of a classical system of identical point charges moving between two walls with parallel surfaces at a distance $d$, charged symmetrically with position-dependent surface charge densities. Specifically, we study the effect of surface charge modulation on the effective force (pressure) between the walls in the Poisson-Boltzmann limit. Based on Monte Carlo simulations at high temperatures, it is predicted that surface charge modulation reduces the pressure between the walls compared to uniformly charged wall surfaces with the same average surface charge density. We restrict ourselves to surface charge modulations in only one direction and, using a general solution of the two-dimensional Liouville equation, we construct exact solutions for the electrostatic potential. The surface charge density on the walls is generated inversely from this potential, which means that our exact results apply to a limited set of models with a specific variation of the surface charge density with distance $d$. Explicit analytical results show that surface charge modulation can both increase (small distances $d$) and decrease (large $d$) the pressure between the walls.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼含计算验证）。判断依据关键词：Exact Poisson-Boltzmann solutions、Liouville equation、exact solutions、Monte Carlo simulations（用于预测/验证，非主要手段）。；研究对象：经典点电荷（反离子）在两个平行壁面之间的热平衡体系；两壁间距为 d，壁面带有对称的、位置依赖的表面电荷密度（即表面电荷调制），研究表面电荷调制对壁面间有效力（压强）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 表面电荷调制相对于具有相同平均表面电荷密度的均匀带电壁面，会降低壁面间的压强（基于高温 Monte Carlo 模拟的预测）；但精确解析结果表明，表面电荷调制在小间距 d 时可增大压强，在大间距 d 时可减小压强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：表面电荷调制相对于具有相同平均表面电荷密度的均匀带电壁面，会降低壁面间的压强（基于高温 Monte Carlo 模拟的预测）；但精确解析结果表明，表面电荷调制在小间距 d 时可增大压强，在大间距 d 时可减小压强。；创新点：针对仅沿一个方向调制的表面电荷分布，借助二维 Liouville 方程的一般解给出了精确的 Poisson-Boltzmann 解，并揭示了表面电荷调制对壁面间压强既有增强（小 d）又有减弱（大 d）的双重效应；但摘要指出该精确结果仅适用于表面电荷密度随距离 d 有特定变化的有限模型集合。
papers.method_zh: Poisson-Boltzmann 框架；利用二维 Liouville 方程的一般解构造静电势的精确解；表面电荷密度由该势反推生成；辅以高温下的 Monte Carlo 模拟。

papers.title: Bias-driven circular currents in a quantum ring: Effects of electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions
papers.abstract: The phenomenon of bias-driven circular charge and spin currents in a ring nanojunction is investigated in the presence of electron-electron (e-e) and electron-phonon (e-ph) interactions within a tight-binding framework based on the non-equilibrium Green's function formalism. The Lang-Firsov transformation is employed to map the interacting system onto an effective electronic model, which is subsequently treated within the Hartree-Fock mean-field scheme. By exploring the interplay among e-e interaction, e-ph coupling, and electrode-ring interface sensitivity, several intriguing features emerge in both circular charge and spin currents that, to the best of our knowledge, have not been reported previously. In addition to bias-driven circular currents, charge and spin-dependent junction currents through the nanojunction are also analyzed. Selective spin transport is achieved, leading to a high degree of spin polarization. All four current components, two associated with circular currents and two with transport currents, are systematically inspected over a wide range of parameter regimes to assess the sensitivity of the results to the relevant system parameters. Our findings provide useful insights into charge and spin transport phenomena in interacting nanojunctions with single- and multi-loop geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：tight-binding framework、non-equilibrium Green's function formalism、Lang-Firsov transformation、Hartree-Fock mean-field scheme。摘要中未出现实验测量手段或实验样品制备信息。；研究对象：研究环形纳米结（ring nanojunction）中由偏压驱动的圆形电荷流和自旋流现象，并考察电子-电子相互作用、电子-声子相互作用以及电极-环界面敏感性对输运性质的影响。摘要未明确说明具体材料体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电子-电子相互作用、电子-声子耦合和电极-环界面敏感性的共同作用下，圆形电荷流和自旋流会呈现出此前未报道的新特征；同时可实现选择性自旋输运，并获得高自旋极化。摘要未明确说明这些新特征的具体物理内容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电子-电子相互作用、电子-声子耦合和电极-环界面敏感性的共同作用下，圆形电荷流和自旋流会呈现出此前未报道的新特征；同时可实现选择性自旋输运，并获得高自旋极化。摘要未明确说明这些新特征的具体物理内容。；创新点：摘要指出，在电子-电子相互作用、电子-声子耦合和电极-环界面敏感性共同作用下，圆形电荷流和自旋流出现了此前未见报道的新特征；并实现了选择性自旋输运和高自旋极化。摘要未明确说明相对于已有研究的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 基于紧束缚框架，采用非平衡格林函数形式处理输运问题；使用Lang-Firsov变换将相互作用体系映射为有效电子模型，再在Hartree-Fock平均场方案下处理。系统分析了四个电流分量，其中两个对应圆形电流，两个对应输运电流，并在较宽参数范围内考察其对相关系统参数的敏感性。

papers.title: Detection of acoustic phonons in carbon by Raman spectroscopy
papers.abstract: We detected acoustic phonons in graphite and diamond by Raman spectroscopy supported by density functional theory calculations. The activation of these normally forbidden Raman modes was achieved via lattice amorphization in case of graphite and by boron doping in case of diamond. The doping-induced Raman signal in diamond was identified with substitutional boron of tetrahedral symmetry via its dependences on excitation wavelength and polarization. Comparison of the Raman spectra of amorphized graphite and heavily boron-doped diamond suggests the emergence of graphitic-like disorder in the diamond lattice. The reported approach is not limited to carbon and can be extended to a wide range of other materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 计算）。关键依据：摘要中既有 Raman spectroscopy 实验测量，又有 density functional theory calculations 支持。；研究对象：石墨（graphite）和金刚石（diamond）中的声学声子（acoustic phonons），以及通过非晶化和硼掺杂激活的通常拉曼禁戒模式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过晶格非晶化（石墨）和硼掺杂（金刚石）激活了通常拉曼禁戒的声学声子模式；金刚石中掺杂诱导的拉曼信号来源于具有四面体对称性的替位硼，且非晶化石墨与重硼掺杂金刚石的拉曼谱比较表明金刚石晶格中出现了类石墨的无序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过晶格非晶化（石墨）和硼掺杂（金刚石）激活了通常拉曼禁戒的声学声子模式；金刚石中掺杂诱导的拉曼信号来源于具有四面体对称性的替位硼，且非晶化石墨与重硼掺杂金刚石的拉曼谱比较表明金刚石晶格中出现了类石墨的无序。；创新点：利用晶格非晶化和硼掺杂两种手段激活了碳材料中通常拉曼禁戒的声学声子模式，并通过拉曼光谱探测到这些声学声子；该方法不限于碳材料，可推广到其他多种材料。
papers.method_zh: Raman spectroscopy（拉曼光谱），辅以 density functional theory calculations（密度泛函理论计算）；通过激发波长和偏振依赖性来鉴别金刚石中替位硼的拉曼信号。

papers.title: Surface-bulk hybridization enhances the Berry curvature dipole in GaAs(110)
papers.abstract: Symmetry breaking at crystalline boundaries can enable electronic responses that are forbidden in the bulk. Here, we investigate the Berry curvature dipole (BCD) at GaAs(110) surfaces using first-principles calculations. While the BCD vanishes in bulk GaAs due to symmetry constraints, the reduced surface symmetry permits a finite dipole. We show that surface relaxation promotes hybridization between bulk and surface states, which strongly influences the surface BCD. Specifically, in unrelaxed slabs, the BCD arises predominantly from interband coupling among exponentially localized surface states lying within the projected bulk band gap. Surface relaxation shifts these states into the energy range of the bulk continuum, transforming them into surface resonances and promoting hybridization with bulk-like states. This hybridization generates pronounced Berry-curvature hot spots, resulting in an overall enhancement of the BCD. Our results highlight the importance of surface relaxation for accurately describing surface--bulk hybridization, which in turn plays a key role in Berry-curvature-driven responses at crystalline boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：first-principles calculations（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：GaAs(110) 表面的 Berry curvature dipole（贝里曲率偶极），以及表面-体态杂化对该表面 BCD 的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 体态 GaAs 因对称性约束 BCD 为零，而 GaAs(110) 表面因对称性降低允许有限 BCD；表面弛豫将原本位于投影体能隙内的局域表面态移入体能带连续区，使其转变为表面共振态并与体态杂化，产生显著的贝里曲率热点，从而整体增强 BCD。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：体态 GaAs 因对称性约束 BCD 为零，而 GaAs(110) 表面因对称性降低允许有限 BCD；表面弛豫将原本位于投影体能隙内的局域表面态移入体能带连续区，使其转变为表面共振态并与体态杂化，产生显著的贝里曲率热点，从而整体增强 BCD。；创新点：揭示了表面弛豫对表面-体态杂化的重要影响，并表明这种杂化是增强晶体边界处贝里曲率驱动响应（BCD）的关键机制；强调了准确描述表面-体态杂化必须考虑表面弛豫。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），具体泛函/参数设置在摘要中未明确说明。

papers.title: Intrinsic switching leads to oxygen diffusion and breakdown in hafnia ferroelectrics
papers.abstract: Conventional ferroelectrics exhibit well-defined polarization states linked through electric switching. In fluorite-structured ferroelectrics like hafnia, though, switching and oxygen diffusion seem to coexist, enriching the nature of ferroelectricity. Here we address the intrinsic, room-temperature switching and diffusion kinetics of hafnia ferroelectrics using machine-learning molecular dynamics. We identify two distinct switching mechanisms that are both active at realistic time scales. Critically, our simulations reveal that, because the lattice does not dissipate fast enough the heat originating from localized switching events, these two processes concatenate in an avalanche-like manner leading to oxygen conduction. Our results thus show that intrinsic switching leads to breakdown in hafnia ferroelectrics. They also suggest how this outcome might be avoided through suitably designed field pulses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：machine-learning molecular dynamics（机器学习分子动力学模拟），摘要中未出现实验手段相关描述。；研究对象：萤石结构的铪基铁电体（hafnia ferroelectrics）中的本征室温翻转（switching）与氧扩散（oxygen diffusion）动力学，以及二者耦合导致的氧传导与击穿现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模拟识别出两种在现实时间尺度下均活跃的翻转机制；由于晶格无法足够快地耗散局域翻转事件产生的热量，这两种过程以雪崩式方式级联，导致氧传导，即本征翻转会引发铪基铁电体的击穿。摘要还指出，通过合理设计电场脉冲可能避免这一结果。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模拟识别出两种在现实时间尺度下均活跃的翻转机制；由于晶格无法足够快地耗散局域翻转事件产生的热量，这两种过程以雪崩式方式级联，导致氧传导，即本征翻转会引发铪基铁电体的击穿。摘要还指出，通过合理设计电场脉冲可能避免这一结果。；创新点：揭示了铪基铁电体中翻转与氧扩散共存的内在机制：两种翻转机制在现实时间尺度下均活跃，且因晶格散热不足而以雪崩方式级联导致氧传导和击穿；并提出可通过设计电场脉冲规避该击穿。
papers.method_zh: 机器学习分子动力学（machine-learning molecular dynamics）模拟，在室温下研究本征翻转与扩散动力学。

papers.title: Electrolyte Dependent Structure Transport Relationships in Electrodeposited Prussian Blue Analogue Thin Films
papers.abstract: Understanding how electrolyte composition influences charge storage in Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) requires clarifying the coupled effects of structural disorder and ion transport. Here, we investigate Fe-, Co-, and Ni-based hexacyanoferrate thin films electrodeposited from KCl, NaCl, NH4Cl, and LiCl electrolytes under identical electrochemical conditions. Although all films retain the cubic PBA structure, electrolyte identity produces pronounced differences in lattice parameters, defect concentration, and local coordination environments. Na+ promotes lattice expansion accompanied by increased vacancy formation, microstrain, and structural heterogeneity, whereas K+ and NH4+ yield more structurally coherent frameworks. Raman spectroscopy shows that increasing structural disorder broadens the distribution of local coordination environments and correlates with increasingly dispersed electrochemical behavior. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy further reveals coupled ion-electron transport, with impedance increasing by more than one order of magnitude from FeHCF to NiHCF. Notably, the CPE exponent decreases systematically with Raman band broadening, establishing a direct correlation between structural disorder and transport dispersion. These results demonstrate that electrolyte identity controls not only lattice dimensions but also the organization and connectivity of defect networks, highlighting structural coherence and accessible transport pathways as key factors governing electrochemical performance in PBA thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键依据：论文采用电沉积制备薄膜，并进行了 Raman 光谱和电化学阻抗谱等实验表征，摘要中未提及计算或理论框架。；研究对象：研究对象是电沉积制备的 Fe、Co、Ni 基六氰合铁酸盐（hexacyanoferrate）普鲁士蓝类似物（PBA）薄膜，关注电解质组成（KCl、NaCl、NH4Cl、LiCl）对薄膜结构无序、离子输运和电荷存储的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电解质种类会显著改变 PBA 薄膜的晶格参数、缺陷浓度和局域配位环境：Na+ 促进晶格膨胀并增加空位、微应变和结构异质性，而 K+ 和 NH4+ 得到结构更一致的框架；结构无序增加会拓宽 Raman 局域配位环境分布，并与电化学行为分散化及 CPE 指数下降相关，表明结构无序与输运色散之间存在直接关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电解质种类会显著改变 PBA 薄膜的晶格参数、缺陷浓度和局域配位环境：Na+ 促进晶格膨胀并增加空位、微应变和结构异质性，而 K+ 和 NH4+ 得到结构更一致的框架；结构无序增加会拓宽 Raman 局域配位环境分布，并与电化学行为分散化及 CPE 指数下降相关，表明结构无序与输运色散之间存在直接关联。；创新点：摘要中强调的新意在于：在相同电化学条件下系统比较不同电解质对 Fe/Co/Ni 基 PBA 薄膜结构无序和输运的影响，并建立 Raman 带展宽与 CPE 指数下降之间的直接关联，说明电解质不仅控制晶格尺寸，还控制缺陷网络的组织与连通性，从而影响电化学性能。
papers.method_zh: 在相同电化学条件下从 KCl、NaCl、NH4Cl、LiCl 电解质中电沉积 Fe-、Co-、Ni-基六氰合铁酸盐薄膜；用 Raman 光谱表征局域配位环境和结构无序；用电化学阻抗谱研究耦合的离子-电子输运；并分析晶格参数、缺陷浓度、微应变和 CPE 指数等。

papers.title: Electromagnetic Proximity Effects and Spontaneous Currents in Clean Superconducting Heterostructures
papers.abstract: When ferromagnets are brought into contact with a superconductor, superconducting proximity effects give rise to a variety of interesting phenomena, including oscillatory singlet Cooper-pair amplitudes and long-ranged odd-frequency triplet correlations induced by the exchange interactions in the ferromagnets. From an electrodynamic perspective, however, it is equally important to understand when and how spontaneous currents can emerge. To investigate the interplay between electromagnetic and conventional superconducting proximity effects, we study clean ferromagnet/ferromagnet/superconductor spin-valve heterostructures in which the relative angle between the two ferromagnetic layers can be tuned. Our approach is based on a self-consistent numerical solution of the coupled Bogoliubov-de Gennes and Maxwell equations, providing a microscopic description capable of resolving physics on atomic length scales. Several notable features emerge. In both the weak- and strong-exchange-field regimes, the central ferromagnetic layer plays a dominant role in generating sizable spontaneous currents when its exchange-field strength is varied. We further find that the resulting electromagnetic response extends across the entire superconducting layer, in sharp contrast to the short-ranged inverse proximity effect. In noncollinear configurations, the electromagnetic proximity effect also reconfigures the local magnetic-field orientation and reduces the angular mismatch between the fields in the two ferromagnetic layers. The long-ranged odd-frequency triplet amplitudes are consequently modified by the orbital response, which alters the underlying quasiparticle states by changing their momentum-space structure. Finally, our framework can be naturally generalized to other superconducting spintronic systems, possibly including Josephson junctions and altermagnet/superconductor heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：self-consistent numerical solution、coupled Bogoliubov-de Gennes and Maxwell equations、microscopic description。；研究对象：清洁的铁磁体/铁磁体/超导体自旋阀异质结构，其中两层铁磁层之间的相对角度可调。研究的具体物理现象是电磁邻近效应与自发电流，以及它们与传统超导邻近效应（包括振荡的单重态库珀对振幅和长程奇频三重态关联）之间的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱交换场和强交换场两种区域中，当中心铁磁层的交换场强度变化时，该层在产生可观测的自发电流方面起主导作用；由此产生的电磁响应延伸至整个超导层，与短程的逆邻近效应形成鲜明对比。在非共线构型中，电磁邻近效应还会重构局域磁场方向，减小两层铁磁层中磁场之间的角度失配，并因此修改长程奇频三重态振幅。

papers.method_zh: 基于Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程与Maxwell方程耦合的自洽数值求解，提供能够分辨原子长度尺度物理的微观描述。

papers.title: C 1s core-level fingerprints of reconstructed titanium vacancies in titanium carbide
papers.abstract: Recent first-principles searches predict that a titanium vacancy in rocksalt TiC is not an empty octahedral site but can reconstruct through the formation of carbon Frenkel pairs and short C-C bonds. We determine the C 1s signatures of these local structures and assess whether they remain specific in the presence of disordered carbon. Site-resolved binding energies were calculated with a self-consistent core-hole method for an unreconstructed vacancy and four representative C-C-bonded reconstructions. The unreconstructed vacancy shifts its nearest-neighbour C 1s level by only -0.36 eV. In contrast, the largest positive shift in each reconstructed model ranges from 2.34 eV to 2.80 eV. The large shifts occur at carbon atoms participating in the reconstructed C-C network and correlate with markedly less negative Mulliken charges, providing candidate local fingerprints of vacancy reconstruction. However, an exploratory TiC/amorphous-C model shows that disordered carbon environments can extend into the same high-binding-energy range. Overall, the calculated shifts provide reference energies for experimental searches for reconstructed Ti vacancies in TiC.

papers.title: Statistical mechanics of classical fractons on a line
papers.abstract: We study the equilibrium statistical mechanics of one-dimensional classical Machian fractons: particles whose dynamics conserves a global dipole moment and whose Hamiltonian couples momentum differences through a position-dependent pair-inertia kernel. Compactly supported interaction kernels have a divergence in the Gibbs partition function, and have been shown to break ergodicity and symmetry by forming non-equilibrium steady states with particle clusters, evading the Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman theorem. In this paper, we consider kernels with non-compact support and study their ergodic properties. For exponentially decaying kernels, graph-Laplacian and matrix-tree bounds provide an extensive free energy suggesting that a putative statistical mechanical description is valid. Similarly, uniform non-local kernels have a super-extensive free energy and require a Kac rescaling. A generalized Hohenberg--Mermin--Wagner--Coleman argument, supported by finite-size scaling, implies symmetry-breaking density order parameter vanishes at all wave vectors melting the long-range translation-breaking density order of compact kernels. To study the resulting equilibrium ensemble, we construct a nonreversible event-chain Monte Carlo (ECMC) algorithm that samples the coupled position-momentum phase space while preserving the dipole moment and total momentum. The ECMC sampling is shown to quantitatively match long time-averaged quantites in Hamiltonian dynamics. The equilibrium liquid exhibits preferred short-range clustering and strongly non-Gaussian single-particle momentum tails associated with the correlated nature of positions and momenta. This paper provides a detailed investigation into the equilibrium liquid properties of the non-compact regime, whilst the companion paper investigates the mechanisms that relax the liquid.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：equilibrium statistical mechanics、Gibbs partition function、graph-Laplacian and matrix-tree bounds、generalized Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman argument、finite-size scaling、event-chain Monte Carlo。摘要中未提及任何实验或第一性原理计算，属于经典统计力学理论研究。；研究对象：一维经典 Machian fractons（分形子）体系：粒子动力学守恒全局偶极矩，哈密顿量通过位置依赖的对惯性核耦合动量差。具体研究了非紧支撑（non-compact support）相互作用核（指数衰减核与均匀非局域核）的平衡统计力学与遍历性质，以及由此形成的平衡液态的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于指数衰减核，图拉普拉斯和矩阵树界给出广延自由能，表明存在有效的统计力学描述；均匀非局域核则给出超广延自由能，需要 Kac 重标度。广义 Hohenberg-Mermin-Wagner-Coleman 论证结合有限尺寸标度表明，对称破缺的密度序参量在所有波矢下消失，从而熔化了紧支撑核所存在的长程平移破缺密度序。平衡液态表现出偏好短程团簇和强非高斯单粒子动量尾部，与位置和动量的关联性质有关。

papers.title: Interplay of Composition, Crystallinity, and Chemical Structure in CoHCF and NiHCF Thin Films Prepared at Different Temperatures
papers.abstract: Understanding how growth conditions govern structural order and ion transport in Prussian blue analogues (PBAs) thin films is essential for optimizing their electrochemical performance. Here, cobalt and nickel hexacyanoferrate (CoHCF and NiHCF) thin films were electrodeposited potentiostatically at temperatures between 20 and 60 degrees C. A combination of cyclic voltammetry, scanning electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, and Raman spectroscopy was employed to elucidate the interplay between composition, crystallinity, and chemical structure. Under identical conditions, CoHCF exhibits a maximum current density approximately 2.2 times higher than NiHCF, indicating significantly faster electrochemical kinetics. X-ray diffraction reveals temperature-dependent lattice expansion without phase transitions, with a maximum near 40 degrees C, associated with structural relaxation and compositional variations. Raman spectroscopy further reveals temperature-dependent local structural evolution, where cyanide band narrowing at intermediate temperatures indicates improved short-range order, while band broadening at higher temperatures reflects increased defect density. These findings demonstrate that temperature-controlled defect redistribution governs both short- and long-range structural order in PBA thin films, directly influencing ion transport and electrochemical response. This work provides new insights into structure-property relationships in PBAs and establishes deposition temperature as a key parameter for tuning electrochemical functionality in hexacyanoferrate-based electrodes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：electrodeposited potentiostatically、cyclic voltammetry、scanning electron microscopy、X-ray diffraction、Raman spectroscopy。；研究对象：钴基和镍基六氰基铁酸盐（CoHCF 和 NiHCF）普鲁士蓝类似物（PBA）薄膜，研究其在不同电沉积温度（20–60 °C）下组分、结晶性与化学结构之间的相互作用，以及其对离子输运和电化学性能的影响。

papers.title: Intersection Exponents of Simple Random Walks in Two and Three Dimensions
papers.abstract: The probability that several independent random walks avoid one another decays algebraically with the number of steps $N\to\infty$ in two and three dimensions, $P_N\sim N^{-ξ/2}$, where the intersection exponent $ξ$ depends on the number of random walks. More generally, one may consider several groups of independent random walks, with intersections allowed within each group and forbidden between different groups. We first study intersection exponents in two dimensions, where our results agree with the known exact formulas and test the numerical approach. In three dimensions, where no general exact expression is known, we determine $ξ$ for a range of cases. For two groups containing $k$ and $m$ random walks, respectively, we obtain the exponents $ξ(k,m)$ for $k=1,2$ and $m=1,2,\ldots,7$. We further extend $m$ to a continuous parameter $λ$, allowing us to obtain numerical values for $ξ(k,λ)$ for $k=1,2,3$ and $0.25\leqλ\leq3$. Away from the smallest moment orders, these functions increase with $λ$ with decreasing slopes, as expected from the strict concavity of Brownian intersection exponents. We also investigate three-group configurations for several representative cases. The resulting integer and continuous exponents supply numerical values for analytical studies of non-intersecting random paths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：numerical approach、determine ξ、obtain numerical values、numerical values for analytical studies。；研究对象：二维和三维空间中多组独立简单随机行走之间的相交指数（intersection exponents），即多组随机行走之间禁止相交时其概率随步数 N 的幂律衰减行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维中计算结果与已知精确公式一致；在三维中（无一般精确表达式）确定了多组随机行走的相交指数 ξ(k,m)（k=1,2；m=1,…,7），并推广到连续参数 λ 得到 ξ(k,λ)（k=1,2,3；0.25≤λ≤3）；这些函数随 λ 增大而增大且斜率递减，符合 Brownian 相交指数严格凹性的预期。

papers.title: Ab initio study of magnetic Cu$_2$Sb compounds related to antiferromagnetic CuMnAs
papers.abstract: The antiferromagnetic metal CuMnAs has become a workhorse of antiferromagnetic spintronics. A broad range of phenomena has been demonstrated in this material, most notably current-induced switching and heat-driven quench switching, both first realized in CuMnAs. CuMnAs belongs to a much larger family of intermetallic compounds sharing the tetragonal Cu$_2$Sb-type structure, yet the magnetic properties of most of its members, and their potential for spintronics, have not been studied. Here we report a systematic density functional theory (DFT) study of the magnetic and electronic structure of more than 50 compounds of this family, intended to guide future theoretical and experimental work toward spintronic applications. We find a wide range of magnetic ground states, among them over 20 new antiferromagnetic candidates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：ab initio、density functional theory (DFT) study、systematic DFT study。；研究对象：与反铁磁金属 CuMnAs 同属四方 Cu$_2$Sb 型结构的金属间化合物家族，具体研究了该家族中 50 多种化合物的磁性和电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在这 50 多种化合物中发现了广泛的磁性基态，其中包括 20 多种新的反铁磁候选材料。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在这 50 多种化合物中发现了广泛的磁性基态，其中包括 20 多种新的反铁磁候选材料。；创新点：CuMnAs 虽已成为反铁磁自旋电子学的核心材料，但其所属的 Cu$_2$Sb 型结构大家族中大多数成员的磁性和自旋电子学潜力尚未被研究；本工作首次对该家族 50 多种化合物进行了系统的 DFT 研究，并识别出 20 多种新的反铁磁候选材料，旨在为未来理论和实验的自旋电子学应用研究提供指导。

papers.title: Thermodynamic efficiency of communication channels
papers.abstract: We identify a broad class of communication channels that captures common physical constraints in both artificial and natural systems and derive bounds on their thermodynamic cost. We find that the entropy production per channel use is bounded from below by the input-output mutual information, and their ratio -mutual information divided by entropy production- defines the thermodynamic efficiency. Unlike previous studies of energy-constrained communication channels, our analysis shows that thermodynamic costs must be assigned not only to the input symbols themselves, but also to transitions between successive symbols. As a result, maximizing thermodynamic efficiency favors a biased input that switches only rarely, rather than the capacity-achieving input. For the binary symmetric channel, this preference emerges through a pitchfork bifurcation that spontaneously breaks the symmetry of the channel. A minimal model of cellular sensing exhibits the same phenomenon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：identify a broad class of communication channels、derive bounds、analysis shows、minimal model exhibits the same phenomenon。摘要中未涉及具体实验或数值计算细节，以理论推导和模型分析为主。；研究对象：一类广泛的通信通道（communication channels），涵盖人工和自然系统中的常见物理约束；具体分析了二元对称信道（binary symmetric channel）以及细胞感知的最小模型（minimal model of cellular sensing）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 每次通道使用产生的熵下界由输入-输出互信息决定，二者之比定义为热力学效率；与以往能量约束通信通道研究不同，热力学成本不仅归于输入符号本身，还归于相邻符号之间的跃迁，因此最大化热力学效率倾向于使用极少切换的偏置输入，而非达到信道容量的输入。对二元对称信道，这种偏好通过叉式分岔（pitchfork bifurcation）自发破缺信道对称性而出现，细胞感知的最小模型也表现出同样现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：每次通道使用产生的熵下界由输入-输出互信息决定，二者之比定义为热力学效率；与以往能量约束通信通道研究不同，热力学成本不仅归于输入符号本身，还归于相邻符号之间的跃迁，因此最大化热力学效率倾向于使用极少切换的偏置输入，而非达到信道容量的输入。对二元对称信道，这种偏好通过叉式分岔（pitchfork bifurcation）自发破缺信道对称性而出现，细胞感知的最小模型也表现出同样现象。；创新点：首次指出热力学成本必须分配给连续符号之间的跃迁，而不仅是输入符号本身；由此得出最大化热力学效率的输入并非容量达成的输入，而是极少切换的偏置输入；并在二元对称信道中揭示了叉式分岔导致对称性自发破缺的机制，且在细胞感知最小模型中验证了该现象的普适性。

papers.title: Fractional Quantum Geometry in Topological Mott Regime
papers.abstract: Inspired by recent interests in quantum geometry in electronic bands, we consider a two-dimensional topological Mott insulator, i.e. chiral spin liquid, whose spinon bands develop nontrivial band topological and quantum geometry. The virtual polarization of the gapped charge sector transfers the electromagnetic drive to the charge-neutral spinons through the emergent U(1) gauge field, producing a tensor Ioffe-Larkin response and enabling two complementary optical protocols for measurements. In the off-shell (low-frequency) regime, a self-calibrated ratio of the physical longitudinal and Hall conductivities yields the spinon Chern number without the microscopic knowledge of the charge response. In the on-shell (resonant) regime, combining the inverse Ioffe-Larkin response with the Kramers-Kronig relation enables reconstruction of the quantum-metric and Berry-curvature spectral densities. Our approach directly applies to the triangular lattice Hofstadter-Hubbard model in Moiré systems, can be well adapted to other triangular lattice antiferromagnets such as Nb$_3$Br$_8$ with appropriate modifications. We establish a unified framework for quantitatively probing the quantum geometry of fractionalized quasiparticles in topological Mott regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：考虑（consider）一个二维拓扑莫特绝缘体、通过涌现U(1)规范场产生张量Ioffe-Larkin响应、建立统一框架（establish a unified framework）等，摘要中未提及具体实验测量或数值计算细节，属于理论方案提出。；研究对象：二维拓扑莫特绝缘体（即手性自旋液体，chiral spin liquid），其自旋子（spinon）能带具有非平凡的能带拓扑和量子几何。具体可应用于莫尔系统中的三角晶格Hofstadter-Hubbard模型，以及三角晶格反铁磁体如Nb₃Br₈。

papers.title: Time-reversal-odd Transport in Odd-Parity Magnets
papers.abstract: Unconventional magnets combining vanishing net magnetization with spin-split electronic structures and anomalous transport have attracted considerable attention. Using spin-group symmetry analysis, we derive general conditions for odd-parity spin splitting in two- and three-dimensional coplanar noncollinear antiferromagnets. We identify a key spin-group symmetry whose relativistic counterpart forbids time-reversal-odd transport and show that breaking it allows such transport in the presence of spin-orbit coupling. Tight-binding calculations validate these symmetry arguments and demonstrate an anomalous Hall effect in a fully compensated odd-parity magnetic state without an external field. By screening a three-dimensional magnetic materials database and constructing two-dimensional heterostructures, we further identify realistic platforms exhibiting pronounced spin-orientation-dependent anomalous Hall and magneto-optical effects. Our results establish a general symmetry framework for time-reversal-odd responses in odd-parity magnets and highlight fully compensated odd-parity magnets as a promising platform for controlling anomalous transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论+计算文章。判断依据关键词：spin-group symmetry analysis（自旋群对称性分析）、derive general conditions（推导一般条件）、Tight-binding calculations validate（紧束缚计算验证）、screening a three-dimensional magnetic materials database（筛选三维磁性材料数据库）、constructing two-dimensional heterostructures（构建二维异质结）。摘要中未提及任何实验测量手段。；研究对象：奇宇称磁体（odd-parity magnets），具体为二维和三维共面非共线反铁磁体（coplanar noncollinear antiferromagnets），其具有零净磁化但存在自旋劈裂电子结构和反常输运。研究的具体物理现象包括时间反演奇输运（time-reversal-odd transport）、反常霍尔效应（anomalous Hall effect）和磁光效应（magneto-optical effects）。

papers.title: Different reconstruction pathways toward superconductivity in TaRhTe4 and TaIrTe4 Weyl semimetals
papers.abstract: Pressure can drive Weyl semimetals toward superconductivity through qualitatively distinct reconstructions of their lattices and normal-state electronic structures. Here, we report the first observation of superconductivity in compressed TaRhTe4. This finding enables a direct comparison of the distinct reconstruction pathways leading to superconductivity in TaRhTe4 and the previously studied TaIrTe4, both of which belong to the TaXTe4 (X = Rh, Ir) family of type-II Weyl semimetals. For TaRhTe4, high-pressure electrical-resistance, Hall effect, and magnetoresistance measurements, together with synchrotron X-ray diffraction and first-principles calculations, reveal a superconducting transition that emerges near 20 GPa, with onset Tc increasing to approximately 2.6 K at 65.2 GPa and zero resistance achieved above 63 GPa. The onset of superconductivity coincides with a progressive lattice distortion, a strong suppression of the positive magnetoresistance, and a continuous decrease of the Hall coefficient toward zero. Calculations further show that additional electron-like bands cross the Fermi level (EF) and that N(EF) increases upon compression. This evolution contrasts with TaIrTe4, where the Hall coefficient initially increases before reversing its pressure dependence near the superconducting threshold, while the structural anomaly is confined to a narrower pressure interval. This comparison indicates that superconductivity in the TaXTe4 family is not tied to a unique critical pressure or a single Fermi-surface reconstruction, but can emerge through distinct material-specific pathways once pressure sufficiently reconstructs the low-carrier Weyl-semimetal-derived state into a multiband metallic regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，结合计算）。判断依据关键词：high-pressure electrical-resistance、Hall effect、magnetoresistance measurements、synchrotron X-ray diffraction（实验）；first-principles calculations（计算）。；研究对象：第二类Weyl半金属家族 TaXTe4（X = Rh, Ir）中的 TaRhTe4 和 TaIrTe4，研究其在压力驱动下向超导转变的晶格与正常态电子结构重构路径。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在压缩的 TaRhTe4 中观察到超导：超导转变在约 20 GPa 附近出现，起始 Tc 在 65.2 GPa 时增至约 2.6 K，63 GPa 以上实现零电阻；该超导出现伴随渐进晶格畸变、正磁阻强烈抑制和霍尔系数持续趋零。与 TaIrTe4 对比表明，TaXTe4 家族的超导并不对应唯一临界压力或单一费米面重构，而是可通过不同材料特异的路径实现。

papers.title: Measure-zero delocalization in the complex plane: exact mobility arcs in a non-Hermitian off-diagonal quasiperiodic lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate Anderson localization in a one-dimensional lattice with non-Hermitian off-diagonal quasiperiodic disorder, extending a recently studied Hermitian mosaic model to the non-Hermitian regime. Using Avila's global theory, we derive the exact Lyapunov exponent and the complete phase diagram in the complex energy plane. This work contains two central findings. First, we discover mobility arcs---open curved segments in the complex plane---as a new class of mobility edges and the generic form of open mobility edges, which coexist with closed mobility rings in a complementary parameter regime. These arcs share the same localization physics as the previously reported mobility lines: eigenstates are delocalized if and only if their energies lie exactly on these sets; any deviation yields localized states. This constitutes a striking measure-zero delocalization phenomenon: delocalized states occupy only zero-measure sets (arcs or lines) in the complex plane, in sharp contrast to the mobility rings, which enclose a finite-area region of delocalized states. Second, we reveal that mobility rings, arcs, and lines all share a common mathematical origin in the generalized Joukowski transformation $P(E) = \frac{1}{2}(u - w^2/u)$, rooted in the algebraic structure of the underlying polynomial: the preimage of the boundary of an elliptical region under the polynomial map $P(E)$ gives the rings, while the branch cut inside this ellipse gives rise to the mobility arcs and lines in the complementary parameter regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键依据：使用 Avila 全局理论（Avila's global theory）进行解析推导，研究一维晶格模型，未涉及实验或数值计算的具体描述。；研究对象：一维非厄米对角准周期无序晶格中的安德森局域化现象，具体为非厄米非对角准周期无序体系，是此前厄米马赛克模型的非厄米推广。

papers.title: Cryogenic Voltage Control of Magnetism in Silicon-Integrated \newline SrTiO$_3$/Fe Heterostructures
papers.abstract: Cryogenic electronics forms a rapidly emerging research domain for high-performance and power-efficient computing applications. Incorporating nanomagnetic components in cryogenic circuitry adds highly valuable functionality, facilitating downscaling, reducing energy consumption and introducing time-reversal symmetry breaking. Furthermore, low-temperature environments enhance magnetic stability and switching efficiency at nanoscale dimensions, reinforcing the potential of cryogenic nanomagnets. To fully leverage these opportunities, magnetic control schemes require alternative options to current-based writing, which is the main bottleneck regarding power consumption and downscaling. In this regard, voltage-based gating of the magnetic state could drastically enhance operational efficiency and integration density. In this work, we investigate cryogenic Voltage Control of Magnetism (VCM) in epitaxial SrTiO$_3$/Fe thin film heterostructures on a CMOS compatible Si substrate. We demonstrate and quantify voltage-controlled modifications of the magnetic domain structure, consistent with electric field-controlled magnetic anisotropy at the Fe/SrTiO$_3$ interface. These findings provide a viable material system for the development of next-generation magnetic domain-based devices for classical and quantum computing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据的关键词：investigate、demonstrate、quantify、epitaxial thin film heterostructures、CMOS compatible Si substrate，表明是实验制备与测量工作。；研究对象：CMOS兼容Si衬底上外延生长的SrTiO₃/Fe薄膜异质结，研究其中的低温电压控制磁性（VCM）现象，具体涉及电场调控Fe/SrTiO₃界面磁各向异性及磁畴结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Si集成SrTiO₃/Fe异质结中实现了低温下的电压控制磁性，观测并定量表征了电压对磁畴结构的调控，该调控与Fe/SrTiO₃界面处电场控制的磁各向异性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Si集成SrTiO₃/Fe异质结中实现了低温下的电压控制磁性，观测并定量表征了电压对磁畴结构的调控，该调控与Fe/SrTiO₃界面处电场控制的磁各向异性一致。；创新点：将低温电压控制磁性（VCM）引入CMOS兼容Si衬底上的外延SrTiO₃/Fe异质结体系，提供了一种可替代电流驱动写入的电压调控方案，为基于磁畴的经典与量子计算器件提供了可行的材料体系。

papers.title: Nullspace-guided Adaptive Bootstrap of Quantum Many-body Systems
papers.abstract: We introduce a nullspace-guided adaptive (NGA) bootstrap method that improves the energy lower bounds of quantum many-body ground states by refining the bootstrap basis in a dynamic and incremental way. At each iteration, the optimized moment matrix reveals a nullspace of saturated positivity directions, which is intuitively interpreted as annihilators of the approximate ground-state subspace. The NGA bootstrap then prunes operators with small nullspace leverage and grows the basis along descendants of these null directions. By applying the NGA bootstrap to the transverse-field Ising chain, we obtain nearly exact energy lower bounds because the algorithm automatically discovers the eigenoperator structure in terms of Jordan-Wigner fermions from a minimal local bootstrap basis. For the Hubbard chain, it improves upon state-of-the-art energy lower bounds by up to two orders of magnitude, reaching errors ranging from $10^{-3}$ down to $10^{-5}$ in the strongly correlated regimes. We further show that the NGA framework can be used to improve the certified two-sided bounds on general observables. In addition, the bootstrap error decreases approximately as a power law with increasing computational resources. These results suggest that our method provides a practical and scalable route toward accurate bootstrap of general quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：bootstrap method、moment matrix、energy lower bounds、算法、数值结果（误差范围、幂律收敛），摘要中未涉及任何实验测量。；研究对象：量子多体系统的基态，具体测试体系为横场 Ising 链（transverse-field Ising chain）和 Hubbard 链（Hubbard chain），关注基态能量下界及一般可观测量双侧界。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NGA bootstrap 方法通过动态、增量地精炼 bootstrap 基，能显著改进量子多体基态能量的下界：在横场 Ising 链上得到近乎精确的能量下界，在 Hubbard 链上把最先进的下界改进了最多两个数量级，强关联区误差达到 10^{-3} 至 10^{-5}；且 bootstrap 误差随计算资源增加近似呈幂律下降。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NGA bootstrap 方法通过动态、增量地精炼 bootstrap 基，能显著改进量子多体基态能量的下界：在横场 Ising 链上得到近乎精确的能量下界，在 Hubbard 链上把最先进的下界改进了最多两个数量级，强关联区误差达到 10^{-3} 至 10^{-5}；且 bootstrap 误差随计算资源增加近似呈幂律下降。；创新点：将零空间信息用于自适应地剪枝与扩展 bootstrap 基（动态增量精炼），从而自动发现以 Jordan-Wigner 费米子表示的本征算符结构；相比已有 bootstrap 方法大幅提升能量下界精度，并可推广用于改进一般可观测量的认证双侧界。
papers.method_zh: 提出 nullspace-guided adaptive (NGA) bootstrap 方法：每次迭代中优化后的矩矩阵给出饱和正性方向的零空间，将其解释为近似基态子空间的湮灭算符；据此剪除零空间杠杆小的算符，并沿这些零方向的“后代”扩展基。在横场 Ising 链和 Hubbard 链上进行数值验证。

papers.title: Strong coupling polarons in cavity quantum materials: limits of cavity-induced electron mass renormalization
papers.abstract: Cavity-induced electron mass renormalization is an important ingredient of many proposals to control material properties through vacuum field modification. What is its ultimate limit? Here this question is answered by (i) noting that this mass renormalization is essentially due to the field-mediated interaction between the electron and the polarizable degrees of freedom in the cavity mirrors, and (ii) directly evaluating the corresponding Feynman path integral for a 2D electron by numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo. The sought upper limit is provided by the Landau-Pekar polaron in the planar geometry. The presented calculation bridges the gap between cavity control and dielectric engineering of material properties.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：Feynman path integral、numerically exact quantum Monte Carlo、直接评估路径积分，属于数值精确计算与理论分析结合的工作，摘要中未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：二维电子在光学腔中的极化子问题，具体为腔诱导的电子质量重整化效应，以及该效应与腔镜中可极化自由度之间的关系。研究体系是腔量子材料（cavity quantum materials）中的强耦合极化子。

papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：腔诱导的电子质量重整化本质上来源于电子与腔镜中可极化自由度之间经由场媒介的相互作用；该质量重整化存在一个由平面几何下 Landau-Pekar 极化子所给出的上限。；创新点：将腔诱导质量重整化归因于电子与腔镜可极化自由度之间的场媒介相互作用，并通过数值精确量子蒙特卡罗直接计算给出了该质量重整化的上限（由平面几何下的 Landau-Pekar 极化子提供），从而在腔控制（cavity control）与材料介电工程（dielectric engineering）之间建立了联系。

papers.title: Analysis of Josephson junctions switching time distributions for the detection of single microwave photons
papers.abstract: We investigate an optimal scheme for the detection of single microwave photons by a Josephson junction through the analysis of its switching times distribution. The proposed analysis is of support for the decision about the existence of the photon field, which is important in the case of rare events. We assume that the cavity and the transmission line are ideal (each photon absorbed to the cavity gives a current pulse as the output of the transmission line) and the photon source is periodic. The employed methodology consists in comparing the switching probabilities of a Josephson junction exposed to a train of current pulses, simulating a weak photon field, with that of the same device in absence of pulses. In both cases, thermal noise can induce thermal activated switchings. The investigation of the unbalance in the number of switching events in the two cases, gives an estimate of the efficiency of the detection. Furthermore, in the assumption of escapes described by Kramers model, it is possible to provide a relationship between the properties of the photons field, the quantum efficiency of the detection process, and the Josephson junctions switching features at finite temperatures.

papers.title: Realization of quantum spin Hall insulator superlattice with emergent multigap-like helical edge states
papers.abstract: The functional quantum spin Hall insulators (QSHI), protected by time-reversal symmetry against single-particle backscattering, hold great promise for dissipationless quantum electronics. Realization of QSHI with gapped helical edge states, which would enable deterministic on/off switching of the edge-channel conductance, is a key requirement for programmable topological circuits. Here, we report realization of superlattice-modulated QSHI HfTe5 hosting emergent multigap-like helical edge states. Using scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy, we identify a reconstruction-induced periodic superlattice modulation in epitaxial monolayer HfTe5 and directly observe multiple gap-like features in the edge channel, accompanied by a series of sharp peaks in the density of states. Combined with theoretical modelling, we attribute the observed edge gap to the finite-width coupling between the two edges significantly enhanced by the superlattice modulation, whereas the sharp peaks are the manifestations of mini-gaps opening at the reduced Brillouin zone boundaries by the periodic modulation of spin-orbit coupling. Notably, these sharp peaks exhibit clear Zeeman splitting under magnetic fields, consistent with the helical nature of the topological edge states. Our results establish a viable route to engineering gapped helical edge states in QSHI and provide a promising platform for topological devices with desired on/off switchability.

papers.title: Scaling behavior of eigenspectrum for entanglement from correlation matrices
papers.abstract: We study the scaling behavior of the eigenvalues of correlation matrices, which characterize the entanglement of a subsystem with its complement part of a total pure state. A most distinguishing feature of entanglement entropy is its logarithmic dependence on the subsystem size for the groundstate of one-dimensional critical systems. Despite its robust universal character and relevance to a wide range of topics, a thorough understanding of this result requires sophisticated mathematical physics techniques or conformal field theory. The aim of our work is to shed light on this from the underlying eigenvalue distribution perspective. The central object is the correlation matrix, which takes the form of Toeplitz or block-Toeplitz matrix. We develop a circulant matrix approximation in the large matrix dimension limit, thus allowing for the individual eigenvalues behavior to be analysed analytically. We find that for both free lattice fermions and transverse field Ising chain, eigenvalues in the bulk of the eigenspectrum scales as $1/L_A$ with the subsystem size. Together with the extensivity of the entropy function, it explains the robust $\log_2 L_A$ scaling of entanglement at criticality. Perturbing from the entanglement-free limit of the Ising chain, we find a smooth crossover behavior to `non-critical' scaling that is characterized by a very slow logarithmic dependence rendering it seemingly a constant entanglement value expected of non-critical systems.

papers.title: Model Fractional Quantum Hall States on Lattices: Exact Parent Hamiltonians and Routes to Realization
papers.abstract: Recent advances in engineered quantum platforms have enabled the realization of bosonic Laughlin states at $ν=1/2$ and brought non-Abelian topological phases within experimental reach. A central theoretical challenge is to develop a unified framework connecting lattice fractional quantum Hall (FQH) model states, exact parent Hamiltonians, and experimentally accessible interactions. We systematically construct Hermitian parent Hamiltonians for which continuum lowest Landau level (LLL) model states sampled on lattice sites are exact zero modes. Using these model manifolds as quantitative references, we find that, within the projected lattice LLL at the flux densities studied, short-range density interactions stabilize Laughlin ground-state manifolds at $ν=1/3$ and $1/4$, while two-body onsite repulsion supports a Moore--Read triplet at $ν=1$. Full multiband calculations reveal a sharp contrast: the Laughlin manifolds remain robust against interband mixing on the studied tori, whereas the Moore--Read triplet becomes less spectrally isolated and eventually undergoes a level crossing with competing states near the interband scale. Our framework provides a theoretical foundation for using lattice model states to guide the search for experimentally accessible Abelian and non-Abelian FQH states.

papers.title: 5DSTEM of Liquid-Phase Nanocrystal Growth Bridges Ensemble Kinetics and Nanoscale Dynamics
papers.abstract: Resolving how ensemble growth kinetics emerge from particle- and grain-level dynamics is essential for predictive control of nanocrystal synthesis. Here, time-resolved four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4DSTEM), extended into five dimensions (5DSTEM) through continuous acquisition, is used to simultaneously resolve morphology, crystallographic orientation, and lattice strain during Au nanocrystal growth in aqueous HAuCl4. Although ensemble growth follows surface-reaction-limited kinetics, individual nanoparticles exhibit distinct pathways, including continuous growth and discrete coalescence through oriented attachment. These pathways display characteristic orientation dynamics, with stable or gradually selected orientations during continuous growth and abrupt reconfiguration followed by alignment during coalescence. At the ensemble level, the out-of-plane orientation distribution is established early and remains stable, whereas in-plane orientations remain broadly distributed without global alignment. Tensile strain develops progressively from particle surfaces and interfaces, directly linking lattice distortion with evolving morphology and crystallographic structure. By connecting ensemble kinetics with particle- and grain-resolved structural evolution, 5DSTEM provides a general framework for uncovering heterogeneous growth mechanisms and for relating synthesis pathways to structure-dependent properties in functional nanomaterials.

papers.title: Kinetic Interference in Translational Control: A Path-Measure Framework for Collision-Triggered Transcript Decay
papers.abstract: I connect two literatures developed independently: the path-measure formulation of non-equilibrium statistical mechanics, where a trajectory action decomposes into a time-antisymmetric (entropic) and time-symmetric (frenetic) sector, and the stochastic modelling of ribosomal traffic on messenger RNA. The biological target is a proposed intervention -- antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) interference with wobble-uridine (U34) modification of transfer RNA -- whose intended effect is not to abolish translation but to perturb its timing, driving ribosome collisions and collision-triggered transcript decay preferentially on high-flux, codon-biased transcripts. Dynamical-activity and large-deviation analyses of generic lattice exclusion models -- notably the symmetric and totally asymmetric simple exclusion processes -- are well established. To my knowledge their formalization specifically for ribosomal traffic queues, translation elongation, and collision-triggered no-go decay remains unoccupied; this paper addresses that narrower gap, not the general one. Two claims here are load-bearing and untested. First, selectivity: transcripts whose loss is therapeutically desirable are separable, by vulnerable-codon-pair burden, from transcripts whose loss is toxic. Second, non-redundancy: the frenetic decomposition yields predictions, specific to ribosomal queueing and collision-triggered decay, not already obtainable from rate-level exclusion-process models or existing activity/large-deviation analyses of exclusion processes. This paper establishes neither. It specifies both as falsifiable tests with pre-registered decision rules, including outcomes under which the framework should be abandoned or narrowed. It is a research programme proposal, not a result. No new experimental, computational, or bioinformatic results are reported.

papers.title: Efficiency of Continuous-Time Quantum Monte Carlo Updates in the Ferromagnetic State of the Doped SU(3) Fermi-Hubbard Model
papers.abstract: We investigate the sampling efficiency in a segment-based continuous-time hybridization-expansion quantum Monte Carlo solver within dynamical mean-field theory for the doped SU(3) Fermi-Hubbard model. Focusing on the low-temperature and strong-coupling regime, where a ferromagnetic state appears upon hole doping away from one-third filling, we compare several update schemes. Adding the double-flip update to the basic local update yields the smallest integrated autocorrelation time of the majority-flavor occupation in the ferromagnetic regime, whereas adding the flavor-permutation update is the most effective in the paramagnetic regime. We further clarify the origin of this difference by analyzing the characteristic occupation changes caused by accepted updates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据的关键词：continuous-time hybridization-expansion quantum Monte Carlo solver、dynamical mean-field theory、update schemes、integrated autocorrelation time。；研究对象：掺杂 SU(3) Fermi-Hubbard 模型在低温强耦合区、偏离三分之一填充时通过空穴掺杂出现的铁磁态，以及该铁磁态中量子蒙特卡洛更新的采样效率问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在铁磁区，将 double-flip update 加入基本局域更新后，多数味占据数的积分自相关时间最小；而在顺磁区，加入 flavor-permutation update 最有效。作者进一步通过分析被接受更新引起的特征占据变化，澄清了这种差异的来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在铁磁区，将 double-flip update 加入基本局域更新后，多数味占据数的积分自相关时间最小；而在顺磁区，加入 flavor-permutation update 最有效。作者进一步通过分析被接受更新引起的特征占据变化，澄清了这种差异的来源。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。摘要主要说明的是在掺杂 SU(3) Fermi-Hubbard 模型铁磁态中系统比较不同更新方案的采样效率，并指出不同磁区最优更新方案不同，但未明确强调相对于已有研究的具体新意。

papers.title: On Energy References when a Magnetic Field is Applied. A Practical Guide to Reference Energies with and without a Magnetic Field
papers.abstract: We present a simple analysis of the energy references and of the magnetic-field-dependent and system-dependent features of the Landau energy levels. The energy reference used in describing Landau quantization is usually taken as given, with the Fermi levels of the electron system and the coupled reservoir aligned in thermal equilibrium. Nevertheless, the dependence of the Landau-level spectrum on magnetic field can make the relation between these energy references less transparent. In this work, we show that when a magnetic field is applied and the confined Landau levels $E_n$ are established, both the Fermi level $E_F$ and the bottom energy $E_0$ remain fixed when the magnetic field varies. We show that the bottom energy $E_0$ is independent of $B$, and determined by a system-dependent field $B_1$, defined by the condition that the first Landau level equals the Fermi energy. In contrast, the minimum of the parabolic well depends explicitly on the magnetic field. The resulting picture provides a simple way of displaying the relative motion of the Landau levels and the fixed Fermi level without introducing a magnetic-field-dependent energy zero.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据的关键词：simple analysis、show that、the resulting picture provides——摘要通篇为解析分析与理论论证，未涉及实验测量或数值计算细节。；研究对象：磁场下朗道能级（Landau energy levels）的能量参考问题，具体涉及朗道量子化谱、费米能级 $E_F$、朗道能级底部能量 $E_0$ 以及抛物线势阱极小值随磁场的依赖关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当施加磁场并形成受限朗道能级 $E_n$ 时，费米能级 $E_F$ 和底部能量 $E_0$ 在磁场变化时均保持固定；其中 $E_0$ 与 $B$ 无关，而由系统依赖的场 $B_1$（定义为第一朗道能级等于费米能级的条件）确定；相反，抛物线势阱的极小值则显式依赖于磁场。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当施加磁场并形成受限朗道能级 $E_n$ 时，费米能级 $E_F$ 和底部能量 $E_0$ 在磁场变化时均保持固定；其中 $E_0$ 与 $B$ 无关，而由系统依赖的场 $B_1$（定义为第一朗道能级等于费米能级的条件）确定；相反，抛物线势阱的极小值则显式依赖于磁场。；创新点：指出在磁场下可将费米能级与朗道能级底部能量视为固定参考，并引入系统依赖的特征磁场 $B_1$ 来标定 $E_0$，从而在不引入磁场依赖能量零点的情况下清晰展示朗道能级相对于固定费米能级的运动。
